node.title: Re^4: instantiating an smtp object
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
Hi [$h4X4_|=73}{],

It's unfortunate that the eval ...; if ($@) ... idiom is still very prevalent, there are many examples in the literature and even the [doc://eval] docs use it! However, the issues I linked to previously have been around for a long time and even though Perl 5.14 [doc://perl5140delta#Exception-Handling|fixed] some of the major issues, as far as I have read the fixes are not perfect yet. The idiom eval { ...; 1 } or ... at least allows for reliable detection of when [doc://eval] failed, even when [doc://$@] gets clobbered.

As for $! vs. $@, I had a look at the source of [mod://Net::SMTP]'s new and it seems that $@ is explicitly set there.

Regards,
-- Hauke D
